meta.title: Add benchmark support to Fortran transpiler
meta.body_summary: Add benchmark mode flag to Fortran transpiler and generate timing/memory JSON output.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit PR adding benchmark mode to Fortran transpiler; self-merged in ~20s with no review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 967 changed lines across 7 files, this is a medium-sized change by absolute volume, but mostly documentation and test output. As an infrastructure addition to a transpiler, it was self-merged instantly without review.

review_details.concern_detail: No review feedback provided; PR was self-merged.
review_details.performance_claim: Add benchmark support to measure timing and memory of Fortran transpiled programs.

core_change_summary.description: Added benchmark mode flag to Fortran transpiler in transpiler.go; updated rosetta tests to support benchmark mode; generated example output for '100-doors-2' program; updated ROSETTA.md checklist with benchmark info.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: ROSETTA.md is largely a documentation update; stub.go and vm_valid_golden_test.go have minor changes.
change_trajectory: Single commit added benchmark flag, test support, and output for first program.

collaboration_trajectory: No human-agent interaction observed; PR was created and self-merged by the same user within 20 seconds.
